title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Tenure Service Share on Billing-Error Corrections
content:
**Clause.** When Bluegate corrects a protection fee charged in billing error on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, it adds to the correction a tenure service credit equal to the service-credit base multiplied by the tenure service share. The tenure service share is read from the covered storage unit's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement — its move-in date and its tenant ledger:

- **0.5** when the covered rental's move-in date is 60 or more whole months before the handling date and the rental's ledger shows no rent payment reversal in the 12 whole months before the handling date;
- **0.25** when the move-in date is at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months before the handling date and the ledger shows no such reversal;
- **0** otherwise.

## Condition table

| Whole months from move-in to the handling date | Rent payment reversal on the rental's ledger in the 12 whole months before the handling date | Tenure service share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 60 or more | none | 0.5 |
| 60 or more | one or more | 0 |
| 24 to 59 | none | 0.25 |
| 24 to 59 | one or more | 0 |
| fewer than 24 | any | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A rental 60 whole months from move-in with a clean ledger gives 0.5; at 59 whole months it gives 0.25.
- A rental 24 whole months from move-in with a clean ledger gives 0.25; at 23 whole months it gives 0.
- A rental 80 whole months from move-in whose ledger shows one rent payment reversal 5 months before the handling date gives 0; the same reversal 13 months before falls outside the 12-month look-back, and the share is 0.5.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

With a service-credit base of 30.00 and a tenure service share of 0.25, the tenure service credit is 7.50.
